0022600117.text: The 76ers (3-0, first in the Atlantic and second in the East) host the Detroit Pistons (2-0, first in the Central and first in the East) in Philadelphia's fourth game of the season, with the 76ers riding a three-game winning streak and a 2-0 home record. Philadelphia will be without Joel Embiid, Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker, and Tacko Fall, while Detroit is missing Jalen Duren and has Ausar Thompson listed as day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the 76ers lost all four meetings in 2025-26, including a 116-93 loss in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026.
